name: Testimony
overview: Scripture reveals testimony as a powerful declaration of God's saving work and faithfulness. The psalmist praises the Lord as a rock, fortress, and deliverer who sustains and protects, encouraging believers to proclaim His deeds among the people. Job’s confident assertion that his Redeemer lives underscores the enduring hope found in Christ. Together, these verses emphasize testimony as both a personal trust in God’s salvation and a public proclamation of His mighty acts.
